title: OS Fundamentals
content:
This PC operates like any other:
• **Double-click** icons to launch.
• **Drag** title bars to move; use the **bottom-left icon** if top is off-screen.
• **Right-click** Desktop or Taskbar for window management and Resets.
• **Start Menu** houses all apps and quick search.

title: Settings & User Profile
content:
Manage your identity in the **Control Panel > User Profile**:
• **Sync:** Changes to Name or Icon here update your Login Screen and Saves instantly.
• **Assets:** View live links to your Bank, Wallets, and Property.
• **Email:** Open the **Mail Client** to register unique addresses with providers like yoboo.com or eye.com.

title: APP Store>Wallet APP>BANK
content:
Manage wealth across two core apps:
• **Universal Wallet:** A dashboard for ALL your Government and Crypto holdings. Purchase **Upgrades** here to link more wallet IDs.
• **OffChainBank:** Use the **Vault** to keep cash safe from theft. Use **Exchange** to swap Gov currencies based on live market rates.

title: Upgrade Hardware & End Processes
content:
Monitor performance in the **Process Manager** (Right-click Start):
• **System Limits:** View your real CPU, GPU, RAM, and WiFi limits.
• **Live Load:** See how much CPU/RAM each app uses. Use **End Task** to kill processes.
• **Storage:** Dynamically synced with your local file count and size.

title: Find new Media & Sell your Files
content:
Your data is stored in the **Explorer**:
• **My Music:** Reorganized into real folders. Double-click songs to play.
• **Media Player:** Plays playlists sequentially. If a folder contains 'art1.jpg', it will display the artwork while you listen. Use Skip/Back to navigate.

title: Getting Started - you have a email waiting
content:
Your first assignment:
1. Open the **App Store**.
2. Download and Install the **Mail Client**.
3. Open it and create your first encrypted account.

Good luck, operative.
